display.title: A Sichah for Chanukah: Only Pure Oil
display.summary_short: A Chanukah sichah the Rebbe spoke to the children of Tzivos Hashem, read and explained: the Jews wanted only pure oil, and we too should want only what is fully kosher.
display.summary_long: As Chanukah begins, the storyteller studies a sichah the Rebbe spoke to children at a Tzivos Hashem Chanukah rally, reading the Rebbe's Yiddish words and explaining them in English. When the Jews returned to the defiled Beis HaMikdash, they found only impure oil. Halachah would have let them use it, but they refused, determined to light the Menorah only with pure olive oil. Because they wanted it so sincerely, Hashem let them find one sealed jar and made it burn for eight days until new oil arrived. The Rebbe's lesson for children: when you light up your life, use only 'pure oil.' Eat food that is surely kosher, wear clothes that are kosher and free of shatnez, check your mezuzos and keep only kosher things in your home. The storyteller adds memories of the Rebbe in 770 and a relative whose checked mezuzah brought a blessing for children, and suggests asking, 'Would the Rebbe be happy with this?' The sichah ends with the Rebbe's brachah: every Jewish home becomes a small Beis HaMikdash, and Hashem will help, even with miracles, until we see the great Beis HaMikdash.
display.lesson: When you truly want to do a mitzvah in the best way, Hashem helps you, even with a miracle; keep your food, clothes and home fully kosher, like the pure oil of Chanukah.
